source.check: the thirteen divisions and names read from the Belfast Telegraph's Cookstown nominations report (6 May 1936, p. 3)

note: Triennial election of the rural district councillors. Nominations were received by Mr. James M'Cammon for the eighteen divisions of the district. Only one nomination was received for each division, so there were no contests. The report prints thirteen of the divisions; the others are not listed here. Polling in County Tyrone was fixed for Wednesday 3 June 1936 (Strabane Chronicle, 21 March 1936, p. 4; Belfast News-Letter, 17 March 1936, p. 12); no poll was needed where all seats were filled at nominations. Filed on 1936-06-03, the Tyrone polling day (previously filed under 1936-05-28, 6 Nov 2026). Returned unopposed.
